title: Energizing Crispy Canadian Scamorza Pasta
description: A winey and crumbly post-workout Canadian dish featuring scamorza and double-fry KFC style chicken, made with ayurvedic-rajasic friendly ingredients
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, and a pinch of salt
Dip each piece of chicken breast into the flour mixture, then the eggs, and finally the flour mixture again
Heat about 1/2 inch of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and double-fry the chicken until crispy and golden brown
In a large saucepan, combine the white wine, scamorza cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper, and stir over low heat until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth
Add the cooked pasta to the cheese sauce and toss until the pasta is well coated
Slice the double-fry chicken into strips and add to the pasta and cheese sauce
Season with salt and black pepper to taste
